name: room
text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Add InstantX-ComfyUI’s depth-aware upscaler to EXCAVA’s pipeline first. It preselects sharp edges and textures before upscaling, which directly boosts detail retention—critical for high-res excavator imagery. The trade-off is a 15% slower render time, but the 0.7% quality gain outweighs it for our use case.

name: Torque
text: InstantX-ComfyUI’s depth-aware upscaler won’t fix EXCAVA’s face fidelity drop—it only sharpens edges, not facial features. RealVisXL’s v1.1 face model still risks breaking EXCAVA’s pipeline—its backwash artifacts will corrupt the excavator’s metal textures. Test RealVisXL v1.0’s face model first; if it fails, fall back to InstantX-ComfyUI’s upscaler as a secondary gain.
